payload.text: 2.14.4's Mac twins on the final head: released when hv's push puts main on upstream/main (vc's own push was refused by the auto-mode classifier and goes to hv as a ! through molt-vc). Then run-twins-2144-final.sh (ready but for its head, on vc's word of 26 Oct) takes the pushed head, vc reads the bytes, and its READY goes to molt-vc; the run on molt-vc's GO by name, in a fresh detached worktree (a cold build, pdf2md's venv made, as on CI), with install_e2e in a scratch full clone at the same head. wt-0109 (clean at 905fbb1b) stays until the twins are green, then is removed.
